notes.title: Bridge Constructor Studio is Out Now! 🌉
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600594/5e510b42e45f487e0981ea298b476d768a2afab0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Dear constructors and engineers, [/p][p]It’s time to dust off your hard hats, grab your high-vis gear and get building: [b][u]Bridge Constructor Studio is out now![/u][/b][/p][p][b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b] is a heartfelt tribute to the best-selling [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Bridge-Constructor"]Bridge Constructor series[/url], packed with everything fans love, and more. Whether you're a seasoned builder or just starting out, it's the perfect place to unleash your creativity. [/p][p]Design clever constructions in charming 3D mini-dioramas, then run simulations to see if they stand the test. Blending fan-favorite features with a modern visual style, intuitive controls, no budget limits, and optional challenges, it’s the ultimate bridge-building playground for veterans and newcomers alike. [/p][p]We hope you enjoy [b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b], whether you’re going “hands-on” in the VR version, physically placing each beam and bolt like you’re on-site at the construction, or embracing the “office-job” approach in the non-VR version, planning and testing from the comfort of your desk. Either way, it's the same game, same features, and the same opportunity to build the bridges of your dreams – just with a different feel in the driver's seat. [/p][p]We’re always grateful to hear your feedback, so make sure to let us know what you think right here in the comments or in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3473610"]Community Hub[/url]. [/p][p]We appreciate your support and wish you a lot of fun with this quintessential Bridge Constructor game! [/p][p]All the best and happy constructing! 
ClockStone & Headup[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473610/Bridge_Constructor_Studio/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Play the Bridge Constructor Studio Demo as Part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600594/e8ca45b2f66a76a7833277cae8ae85dd2f5c1a84.jpg"][/img]

Happy Steam Next Fest kick-off day, friends!

Once again, it's about time for the fabulous Steam Next Fest! Until June 16 an endlessly large number of demos are live here on Steam, connected to hundreds of streams, developer specials, and much more. Exciting times for sure, and you definitely don't want to miss out!

And [b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b] is part of the Next Fest circus as well: Hone your engineering skills across a hand-picked set of levels featuring different vehicles, difficulties, and biomes. Build the bridges of your dreams in this latest title in our Bridge Constuctor series, that combines all the best parts of its predecessors.

We really hope you will enjoy playing our demo! If you're having a good time, please do us a favor and click on "[i]Follow[/i]" as well as on "[i]Add To Your Wishlist[/i]". If you want to give us feedback on the demo (highly appreciated!), please leave your feedback in the comments or the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3473610"]Steam Community Hub[/url]. That would really help us a lot!

Happy Steam Next Fest to all of you!
ClockStone & Headup


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473610/Bridge_Constructor_Studio/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bridge Constructor Studio announce for a PC release sometime this Summer
notes.content:
Bridge Constructor Studio is the latest in the popular series of physics building puzzlers from developer ClockStone. Originally launched for Meta Quest, they recently revealed a proper PC release is coming.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/bridge-constructor-studio-announce-for-a-pc-release-sometime-this-summer/

notes.title: Bridge Constructor Studio announced in the Bridge Constrcutor Franchise Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600594/3e9016ac78ea8b1c478c99beba01916e5fc088cc.jpg[/img]

Dear constructors and engineers,

we are delighted to announce the latest entry in our beloved Bridge Constructor series: [b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b]!

As you are used to from the series, it is a creative engineering puzzle and sandbox game where you put your engineering skills to the test as you design your own constructions in animated 3D mini-dioramas, then start the simulation to watch your creations face the ultimate stability challenge with large trucks, coaches, monster trucks, etc.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EgB0DeIh-qg

[b]Bridge Constructor Studio[/b] also marks a first for the franchise, as its animated 3D mini-dioramas can be experienced in VR for the first time! But it is also playable in non-VR for all those who don't wan't to build bridges in virtual reality.

Celebrating the announcement, we are holding our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/bridge-constructor-franchise-sale][b]Bridge Constructor Franchise Sale[/b][/url] till May 12 ALL Bridge Constructor games like Bridge Constructor Portal and the latest installment Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead with discounts up to 92% off:

All the best and happy bridge building!
ClockStone & Headup
